FIELDS.NAME: Surplus Military Supplies Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Surplus Military Supplies Co. is a retail business specializing in the sale of military surplus goods sourced exclusively from domestic government auctions and approved military surplus wholesalers. Our operations are designed to comply with all local, state, and federal regulations governing military surplus sales. We offer a wide range of products, including uniforms, field gear, outdoor equipment, and survival supplies. The store operates with a robust inventory management system that tracks item origins, values, and turnover to ensure compliance and reduce risk. We prioritize safety and compliance through extensive staff training on regulatory requirements and the safe handling of military surplus items. Our facilities are equipped with comprehensive fire and water protection systems, ensuring the security of our inventory. Regular inventory appraisals are conducted to maintain accurate valuation and risk assessment, and high-value items are secured in locked storage areas to mitigate theft. We have established procedures for customer interactions, prioritizing liability mitigation and customer safety.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not source from foreign military entities or unverified international suppliers and confirms that all sales of firearms, explosives, or controlled tactical gear are conducted with the necessary permits and licenses. Additionally, comprehensive fire and water protection systems, including sprinklers and alarms, are in place, and we maintain a robust system of regular inventory appraisals and documentation, conducted at least annually.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Military Surplus Accessories LLC, Tactical Gear Distributors Inc.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Theft reported on 05/10/2023; stolen items included military uniforms and tactical gear, valued at $1,200.00; investigation closed with no recovery; status: fully resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: U.L. Listed Class 1, Grade 2 Fire and Burglary Safe, with a combined security rating.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitoring security services with patrols during operating hours and alarm response after hours.
